title: ze_uranus_attack
description:
Here is my new port! Uranus Attack is the last part of the "Carebear" trilogy, the only big upgrade from CSGO is the MARATHON MODE. The map has checkpoints instead of levels, this mode will only disable them.
It shouldn't be TOO hard, but you'll need to beat it to green the map !!

ZE_URANUS_ATTACK!

Everything was going well on your teddy bear planet until the day aliens from Uranus decided to have a first contact with you. Plot-twist, they spread a mysterious gas causing rage syndromes and kidnapped your king! You will have only 1 mission: HUNTING THEM DOWN.

Today I'm happy to introduice you my contest entry for the Mapeadores Zombie Apocalypse Contest!

The map contains 3 checkpoints, making it not too hard for the retarded teams our servers have!
You can obviously try to beat the map without dying once, but that's a different challenge!

Thanks to all the sponsors!
Map done in 2 months
